_comment: S86: mutation gate on the deterministic core only (shared standard C.2). Command runner re-runs the targeted core test suite per mutant.
_exemption: Equivalent-mutant exemption (shared standard C.2): StringLiteral mutations target error-MESSAGE text, not business logic. Asserting exact human-readable message strings is brittle and tests message wording, not behavior. Numeric/operator/conditional mutants are NOT exempt.
